items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I remember it was my band he was saying we better hit it... I could you could always depend on Sharky would be playing

ctx.x: He's a fine looking boy too. Very fine. Very powerful and had a very strong lip. Very fine. I liked his playing fine. I liked his playing a whole lot. I think he was, I think he tried to play a whole lot like Sharky. Didn't he? Or did he? I don't remember. Am I mixed up?
That's been 16 years since I've heard him.
